definitions.gloss: a person who plots a crime together with others
definitions.explanation: Someone who joins with others in secretly planning a crime or wrongdoing. A formal, legal term.

examples.japanese: ⟦{警察|けいさつ}→警察：01393_keisatsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{共謀者|きょうぼうしゃ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{探|さが}している→探す：00493_sagasu⟧。
examples.english: The police are searching for the co-conspirators.

examples.japanese: かれ⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{事件|じけん}→事件：01568_jiken⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{共謀者|きょうぼうしゃ}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: He was named a co-conspirator in the incident.

examples.japanese: {取|と}り{調|しら}べで、ほか⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{二人|ふたり}→二人：00622_futari⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{共謀者|きょうぼうしゃ}がいたこと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{分|わ}かった→分かる：00463_wakaru⟧。
examples.english: The investigation revealed that there were two other co-conspirators.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{共謀|きょうぼう}→共謀：19002_kyoubou⟧ (conspiring together) + ⟦{者|しゃ}→〜者：04662_sha⟧ (person). A formal, legal term for someone who takes part in planning a crime with others.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{事件|じけん}→事件：01568_jiken⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{共謀者|きょうぼうしゃ}: a co-conspirator in a case
- {共謀者|きょうぼうしゃ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{特定|とくてい}する→特定する：19642_tokuteisuru⟧: to identify the co-conspirators

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {共犯者|きょうはんしゃ}: accomplice — one who takes part in committing the crime, not only in planning it
- ⟦{主犯|しゅはん}→主犯：18011_shuhan⟧: principal offender — the leader who plays the central role in a crime
